ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the line $l_1$ passing through point $B(2, 0)$ intersects with the line $l_2: y=2x+8$ at point $P(-1, n)$. What is the value of $n$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text: \textbf{Solution:} Substitute $P(-1, n)$ into $y=2x+8$ to get $n=2\times (-1)+8$. Solving this, we find $n=\boxed{6}$.
